name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Joist Adaptor
tagline: JOIST ADAPTOR FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Joist Adaptor is an accessory used to connect an aluminium joist to the pedestal. Joist adaptors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a twist to lock / unlock when securing the aluminium joist to the pedestal. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Joist Adaptor is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and SikaRoof® VersiFrame® and is installed between the pedestal and the aluminium joist.
